title: My PC Tailscale 4G access path
summary: Enable the existing paired PC bridge to bind to a Tailscale address so the phone can connect over 4G/5G without router port forwarding.

changes.detail: Treat Tailscale CGNAT addresses 100.64.0.0/10 as private authorized addresses for the helper, server origin checks and mobile URL validation.
Document exact PC and phone setup steps for Tailscale over 4G/5G, including no port forwarding, pairing, firewall and helper lifecycle guidance.

validation.name: URL policy test
validation.detail: Local, Tailscale, HTTPS and unsafe URL cases passed.

validation.name: Real 4G/5G session
validation.detail: Requires Tailscale installed and signed in on the user’s PC and phone; no connected device session was available.

validation.name: Windows firewall and agent runtime
validation.detail: Requires running the helper on the target Windows PC.
